title: In vitro biological and in silico molecular docking and ADME studies of a substituted triazine-coordinated cadmium(II) ion: efficient cytotoxicity, apoptosis, genotoxicity, and nuclease-like activity plus binding affinity towards apoptosis-related proteins.
authors: Anjomshoa, Marzieh; Sahihi, Mehdi; Fatemi, Seyed Jamilaldin; Shayegan, Shika; Farsinejad, Alireza; Amirheidari, Bagher
journal: Biometals : an international journal on the role of metal ions in biology, biochemistry, and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究镉配合物的细胞毒性与DNA结合/切割活性，并用分子对接评估其与凋亡蛋白的亲和力，虽涉及DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为小分子-核酸/蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: A cadmium(II) complex containing dppt ligand with the formula [CdCl(2)(dppt)(2)], where dppt is 5,6-diphenyl-3-(2-pyridyl)-1,2,4-triazine was synthesized, elucidated and submitted to in vitro cytotoxicity studies against human breast (MCF-7), glioblastoma (U-87), and lung (A549) cancer cell lines as well as mouse embryo normal cell line (NIH/3T3), in comparison with cisplatin employing MTT assay over 24 and 48 h. The complex exhibited the highest cytotoxic effect against MCF-7 cells among the other three cell lines with IC(50) values of 8.7 +/- 0.5 (24 h) and 1.2 +/- 0.7 microM (48 h). Significantly, flow cytometric assessment of the complex-treated MCF-7 and U-87 cells demonstrated a dose-dependent induced apoptotic cell death. The cellular morphological changes were in concord with cytotoxicity and flow cytometric results. The results of comet assay showed that the complex is able to induce DNA damage in MCF-7 cells. These observations are of importance, as sustained damage to cellular DNA could lead to apoptotic cell death. The results of DNA-binding studies indicated that the complex fits into the DNA minor groove and interacts with DNA via a partial intercalation. Moreover, the complex was able to efficiently cleave pUC19 DNA through a hydrolytic mechanism. The binding affinity between the complex and apoptosis-relevant protein targets including APAF1, Bax, Bcl-2, Cas3, Cas7, and Cas9 was evaluated through molecular docking studies. In silico virtual studies revealed the complex's strong affinity towards apoptosis-related proteins; therefore the complex can act as a potential apoptosis inducer. Physicochemical, pharmacokinetics, lipophilicity, drug-likeness, and medicinal chemistry properties of the complex were also predicted through in silico absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion studies.
abstract_zh: 合成了一种含dppt配体的镉(II)配合物，化学式为[CdCl(2)(dppt)(2)]，其中dppt为5,6-二苯基-3-(2-吡啶基)-1,2,4-三嗪，对其进行了表征，并采用MTT法在24小时和48小时内，与顺铂对比，对其进行了针对人乳腺癌（MCF-7）、胶质母细胞瘤（U-87）和肺癌（A549）癌细胞系以及小鼠胚胎正常细胞系（NIH/3T3）的体外细胞毒性研究。该配合物在四种细胞系中对MCF-7细胞表现出最高的细胞毒性效应，其IC(50)值分别为8.7 ± 0.5微摩尔（24小时）和1.2 ± 0.7微摩尔（48小时）。值得注意的是，流式细胞术评估显示，经该配合物处理的MCF-7和U-87细胞表现出剂量依赖性诱导的凋亡性细胞死亡。细胞形态学变化与细胞毒性和流式细胞术结果一致。彗星实验结果表明，该配合物能够诱导MCF-7细胞中的DNA损伤。这些观察结果具有重要意义，因为细胞DNA的持续损伤可能导致凋亡性细胞死亡。DNA结合研究表明，该配合物嵌入DNA小沟，并通过部分插入方式与DNA相互作用。此外，该配合物能够通过水解机制有效切割pUC19 DNA。通过分子对接研究，评估了该配合物与凋亡相关蛋白靶点（包括APAF1、Bax、Bcl-2、Cas3、Cas7和Cas9）之间的结合亲和力。计算机虚拟研究显示，该配合物对凋亡相关蛋白具有强亲和力；因此，该配合物可作为潜在的凋亡诱导剂。通过计算机吸收、分布、代谢和排泄研究，还预测了该配合物的理化性质、药代动力学、亲脂性、药物相似性和药物化学特性。
